## Purpose
Is the platform live? It polls the user-level status (for the caller's workspace) and shows a status pill in the header.

## Responsibilities
- `useSystemStatus()` queries `statusApi.get` every `UI_HEALTH_POLL_SECONDS` (default 30).
- `HealthIndicator` renders a `StatusPill` linking to `/health`.

## Key elements
`useSystemStatus`, `HealthIndicator`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
UI_HEALTH_POLL_SECONDS.

## Interactions
- Backend `/api/status`. Used by `AppHeader` and `routes/health`.

## Error handling and edge cases
